results.model_generated_result: When you file a chargeback or dispute a charge directly with your credit card company, your account with us enters a temporary dispute hold. Here is what you can expect: (1) Account access: Your account will remain accessible during the initial dispute period. However, if the chargeback is confirmed by your card issuer, your account will be suspended until the dispute is resolved. (2) Service continuation: Active services may be paused if the disputed amount represents an unpaid subscription charge, to prevent accumulating further charges during the dispute. (3) Resolution outcomes: If the dispute is resolved in your favor by the card issuer, any outstanding balance is cleared and your account is closed. If the dispute is resolved in our favor, your account is immediately restored to full active status. (4) Timeline: Bank-initiated disputes typically take 30–90 days to resolve, which is significantly longer than our internal billing dispute process (7 business days). We strongly encourage contacting our billing team directly at billing@company.com before initiating a chargeback — we can often resolve billing errors faster, and your account remains fully active throughout our process.
